result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, traffic signals, and sidewalks. However, the environment lacks modern traffic calming measures, and parked vehicles near the crossing points create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection, particularly the white van on the left, may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection along the curb line.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway across the marked crosswalks.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility crosswalks, curb ramps, and signalization. However, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands leave pedestrians exposed.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair and High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and repaint crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, sidewalks, and curb ramps. However, the environment is dominated by wide asphalt surfaces and lacks dedicated pedestrian signals or physical buffers like street trees, which are typical for industrial-commercial zones.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer (like trees or bollards) between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience in this industrial setting.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical refuge islands or curb extensions result in significant exposure for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide turning radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, which can endanger pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
